input.question: Who is the band associated with the album "Interiors"?

documents.text: Interiors (Quicksand album) Interiors is the third album by American post-hardcore band Quicksand, released on November 10, 2017. It is the band's first studio album since "Manic Compression" (1995), and their first release on Epitaph Records. Quicksand first disbanded in October 1995, about eight months after the release of "Manic Compression", because of internal conflicts. However, the band reunited in 1997, and spent most of the following year writing new material and embarking on their first tour in three years.
